Name: CiriunKitsu's BFAV Swans for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Modification permission was open for this one, so I present Swans for SDV 1.6. Credit goes to Kitsunesune for the artwork and Ciriun for the original BFAV mod ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5981?tab=files]here[/url])

Swans live in coops and produce [s]green and white algea[/s] As of 1.5, swans now produce feathers and eggs that can be turned into mayonnaise!

Enjoy!
